title: The release schema, opt-in activation, release check's declaration half, and the argument loop
objective: Give the release core its declaration and its front door before any step exists. An opt-in `release` catalogue row (D35). The `release:` schema, one table in `lib/config` with a default for every key, refusing a key the declared mode never reads (D37). `release check`'s declaration half, and doctor's note on a block nothing reads. An argument loop that parses every argument before anything acts, so that `--help` anywhere never acts and a bare `release` exits 1 (D36). Everything not yet built exits 3, naming the work package that builds it.
